column1: # Chapter pages, unedited, from the same Wayback raw replays as manifest.tsv
# and on the current template only (.chapter-page-wrapper). One per book, 33
# books, picked from the chapters the archive holds a current capture of:
# first, middle and last chapters of books from 1 chapter to 181.
# content_chars is the whitespace-collapsed visible text of the site's own
# chapter container (article.chapter-content), and heading_number the number
# its heading prints after "Chapter"/"Ch." (arabic or roman; blank when the
# heading opens with anything else) — both measured by a separate bs4/lxml
